To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel filtering-based method for simultaneous object detection and localization in semantic mapping, and that we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach on a real robot.

1) We present a novel filtering-based method for simultaneous detection of objects and localization of their 6 degree of freedom poses in a semantic map, 2) We represent the semantic map with a belief over object class and pose and model inference as a Conditional Random Field, 3) We demonstrate the efficacy our method on a real robot equipped with a Microsoft Kinect sensor, and 4) We demonstrate improved object detection and localization over baseline approaches that treat observations as samples of a scene.

(1) we propose a novel method for semantic mapping that simultaneously detects objects and localizes their 6-DoF poses in a belief state representation, (2) we model our semantic mapping problem as a Conditional Random Field that considers contextual relationships between objects as well as temporal consistency of their poses, and (3) we propose a particle filtering algorithm for inference in our CRF that provides improved object detection, pose estimation, and semantic mapping performance with respect to baseline approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a semantic mapping method to simultaneously detect objects in a scene and localize their pose with respect to a robot.
developing a framework for semantic mapping in which the mapping process is informed by the context of objects and their poses in the scene.
the development of methods for semantic mapping with object detection and pose localization.

the proposed method, Contextual Temporal Map (CT-Map) for Semantic Mapping, is able to detect objects and localize them with respect to a 6 DOF pose in a cluttered environment with a single RGB-D camera.
the CT-Map approach is able to detect and localize objects in the context of a dynamic scene.
our method is a significant improvement over previous methods.
